tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /phyogs bcu dus gsum sogs kyi rjes su/ drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma dam pa khyab bdag 'khor lo'i mgon po ngag dbang kun dga' legs pa'i 'byung gnas theg mchog bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang / bdag med ma/ bir+wa pa/ nag po pa/ ḍā ma ru pa/ a wa dhu ti/ ga ya dhā ra/ 'brog mi shākya ye shes/ bla ma se mkhar chung ba/ zhang dgon pa ba/ bla ma sa skya pa chen po kun dga' snying po/ slob dpon rin po che bsod nams rtse mo/ rje btsun rin po che grags pa rgyal mtshan/ chos kyi rje sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta/ 'gro ba'i mgon po chos rgyal 'phags pa/ zhang dkon mchog dpal/ tshogs sgom pa kun dga' dpal/ nyan chen pa bsod nams brtan pa/ brag phug pa bsod nams bzang po/ chos rje bla ma dam pa/ bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims/ grub chen bud+dhā shrī/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ sems dpa' chen po dkon mchog rgyal mtshan/ bla chen kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ theg chen kun dga' bkra shis/ 'jam dbyangs nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ nya dbon kun dga' dpal/ grub chen kun dga' blo gros/ 'jam dbyangs dkon mchog bzang po/ bdag chen blo gros rgyal mtshan/ rje btsun rdo rings pa chen po/ sgo rum pa kun dga' legs pa/ tshar chen blo gsal rgya mtsho/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug mkhan chen gzhon nu blo gros/ sding ma bslab gsum rgyal mtshan/ rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan/ mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan/ rin chen bsod nams mchog grub/ mkhyen rab byams pa ngag dbang lhun grub/ chos rje blo gsal mchog ldan/ rmor chen rdo rje 'chang / drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma khyab bdag 'khor lo'i mgon po ngag dbang kun dga' legs pa'i 'byung gnas theg mchog bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 kun dga' blo gros/ phyogs bcu dus gsum sogs kyi rjes su zhes par/
